U.note: Polished iOS-style dark calculator with repeat-equals, C/AC, aria labels and keyboard, though the red zero-error text and extra Backspace bar add a little bulk.

V.note: Clean and small with commas and a sensible layout, but it has almost no ARIA, the error is a bare 'Error', and there is no repeat-equals.

W.note: Calm light theme with good contrast, the active operator is highlighted, the backspace key is compact, the font fits to width, and it has full keyboard and ARIA support.

X.note: Smallest source and a handsome dark layout, but the clear key is always AC, ARIA is minimal, and the error replaces the display with plain text.

Y.note: Distinctive LCD-and-hardware look with repeat-equals, percent-aware add/subtract, a clear error caption, and strong tactile keys; slightly more than basic.

Z.note: Friendly warm design with a useful C/CE split, thousands separators and a clear error caption; it has no percent key and a slightly odd '≠ a number' string in the source.
